exposure: type of elective surgery (cesarean section, thyroidectomy, hysterectomy, laminectomy, percutaneous nephrolithotomy, cerebral aneurysm, brain and spinal tumors, vertebral fusion, femur and pelvis fracture, discectomy)
cohort: 100 patients who underwent various elective surgeries from 2019 to 2020.
finding: The study found an overall crossmatch to transfusion ratio of 6.5, with elective surgeries often leading to wasted crossmatched blood, suggesting that routine blood reservation may not be required.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was the most performed elective procedure and had the highest crossmatch to transfusion ratio of 32.
